description: The G1–G6 production approval gate state for one production job (CF-WO-P1-004, Task K). The six gates are the Addendum-01 stage-gate workflow: G1 Visual Planning, G2 Test Production, G3 Editorial Review, G4 Picture Lock, G5 Finishing, G6 Delivery. A gate is PASS, BLOCKED, or WAIVED; WAIVED requires an explicit waiver reason and a named authoriser (the user), and a waiver is recorded, never silent. Gate order is enforced by the orchestrator: G2 cannot pass before G1 passes, and no gate can be skipped by advancing the job state past it. This schema carries no timestamps: gate decisions are audit records of who decided what and why, not wall-clock claims.

gates.description: The six gates, in order. Exactly one record per gate; the orchestrator rejects a gate-state record that is missing a gate, repeats one, or lists them out of order.

decided_by.description: Who decided: the user, or the session id that recorded the decision.

decision_note.description: What was decided and why, in one or two sentences.

gate_id.description: The gate: G1 Visual Planning, G2 Test Production, G3 Editorial Review, G4 Picture Lock, G5 Finishing, G6 Delivery.

status.description: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, PASS, BLOCKED, or WAIVED. A failed gate is BLOCKED, never silently passed; a waiver is WAIVED with a reason, never relabelled PASS.

waiver_reason.description: Required when status is WAIVED: why the gate was waived and who authorised it. Must be absent or empty unless WAIVED.

job_id.description: The production job these gates belong to.

project_id.description: The project these gates belong to.

title: Gate State
